updates.update: Strengthened only when FS_APPEND_FL/equivalent and no cognitive write fd are mandatory. O_APPEND-only variant is REFUTED_AS_SECURITY_BOUNDARY.
Split signed-manifest layout remains likely dominant unless MOLT shows measurable coherence/deployment/recovery benefit.
Loop offset/sizelimit deserves target comparison; privileged setup/operational surface is its cost.
Broker isolation is required but cannot replace kernel monotonic write enforcement.
Local JSON framing produces unacceptable tiny-payload byte amplification; typed binary codec/checkpointing becomes mandatory before integration.
fs-verity protects immutable whole files but forces split state persistence if used directly.
Ratchet metaphor itself has no novelty value; retain only measurable lineage/security properties.
All simulated partial-final-frame cuts rolled back without fabricated state; real kill/power-loss/fs semantics still untested.

strongest_counterhypothesis: A manifest-bound split layout or loop-subrange control provides equal or stronger protection with less storage amplification, replay/compaction complexity, and privilege machinery; MOLT then has no v0.1 justification.
